subject: PO timing and staging-window preflight for booking recognition (ACME)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Staging window preflight: PO timing for Q4 booking recognition (ACME)

Priya / Karthik —

Quick preflight to lock the timing assumptions for ACME so we can close the recognition loop for the Q4 bookings: I attached a short tracker (acme_po_timing_tracker.xlsx) with the current dates pulled from the deal record. Key asks: 

- Confirm expected signed PO arrival date (we need PDF in billing inbox)
- Confirm who at ACME is responsible for sending the invoice to billing@redwood.com and whether they will route via DocuSign or as a standalone PDF
- Identify any procurement review windows that could push PO acceptance into next month (this will affect recognition cutoffs)

Current notes in the tracker: we have a projected start-of-service of 2026-12-01 tied to the PO being in place by 2026-11-25. If PO slips past 11/30 we likely miss Q4 recognition and need to move the booking to FY27.

Please reply with firm dates or a commit review time — finance would like a single agreed milestone to anchor the forecast. I can host a 20‑minute commit call if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — quick update from the deal side: procurement has indicated internal approvals should finish by 2026-11-22, with a target to have the signed PO returned to us by 2026-11-24. I added a row in the shared tracker (link below) with this date.

Operational notes:
- If ACME sends the PO as a DocuSign envelope, billing can accept a DocuSign transaction ID; the PDF delivered by DocuSign to billing@redwood.com is acceptable for recognition.
- If they send as a standalone PDF, we need it to include the purchase order number and total line items to match to the booking.

I added a tentative commit review on 2026-11-25 for finance to sign off; if OLivia (ACME) confirms earlier we can move it up. Link to tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PoTracker

-Karthik

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Summary and next steps for finance forecasting: 

1) Agreed PO target: 2026-11-22 (ACME intends to route signed PDF to billing@redwood.com).
2) Recognition plan: if billing receives the signed PDF (with PO number and totals) by 2026-11-25 EOD UTC, we will include the booking in Q4 recognition. If receipt slips past 2026-11-25 we will reclassify to FY27 bookings.
3) Commit review: schedule a 20‑minute checkpoint with Finance on 2026-11-25 15:00 UTC to confirm delivery and to sign off on recognition (I created a tentative invite).
4) Actions: 
   - Karthik: Please keep the tracker updated and flag if ACME shifts the target date (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PoTracker).
   - Marissa: Prepare the commit memo (one page) for the 11/25 call summarizing exposure if PO misses the window.
   - Rishi: Ready AR for inbound PO processing (billing@redwood.com) and hold the DocuSign handling playbook.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-8342 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8342), DocuSign transaction placeholder (https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123).

I will monitor and escalate if we see risk > 48 hours from the agreed date. Thanks — feel free to update the tracker or reply here if anything changes.
